question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank with the synonym of the underlined word.**

The casual nature of the student __destroyed__ his studies and ________ his future.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ruined**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The synonym of "destroyed" is "ruined".
 
• **Destroyed **means reduced to a state of complete damage or rendered unusable; brought to ruin. (नष्ट किया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example**: *The city was destroyed by the earthquake.*
 
 
 
• **Ruined **means damaged or spoiled to the extent of being no longer usable or functional. (तहस-नहस)
 
 
• **Example**: *The flood ruined all the crops in the field.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence**: *The casual nature of the student destroyed his studies and ruined __his future. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Skyrocketed **means increased rapidly and significantly, often used to describe a sharp rise in prices, numbers, or levels. (आसमान छू रही)
 
• **Rained **is the past tense of the verb "rain," referring to the atmospheric phenomenon where water droplets fall from the clouds to the ground. (बारिश)
 
• **Traced **means followed or investigated the course or development of something, often by tracking or researching its origin or history. (निगाह रखना)
